idea-plugin.name: Branch Tab Title
idea-plugin.description:
Shows the current Git branch and terminal status (⏳ running / ✓ idle) in the project window title, so merged project window tabs on macOS tell you which branch each project is on.
  • Branch is read from .git/HEAD (worktrees supported).
  • Shorten branch names with your own regex: Settings → Advanced Settings → Branch Title.
  • ⏳ appears while any terminal tab of the project has a title starting with ⏳ (set it from your shell, see README).
